meta.title: Delhivery Limited Annual Report 2023-24
meta.fiscal_year_convention: Indian fiscal year April-March; FY24 (also labelled "2023-24") = 1 April 2023 - 31 March 2024. Prior-year comparatives referenced as "a year ago" correspond to FY23 (year ended 31 March 2023).
meta.data_vintage_notes: Financial statements (standalone and consolidated) are for the year ended 31 March 2024 (FY24), audited, with amounts stated in Indian Rupees million (CIN: L63090DL2011PLC221234). Some operational metrics in "Delhivery In Numbers" are point-in-time as of 31 March 2024 or for the Q4 FY24 period specifically (footnoted), rather than full-year FY24 figures, so care is needed matching metric to period. meta.summary: This is Delhivery Limited's Annual Report for FY24 (fiscal year ended 31 March 2024), covering corporate overview, business/operational highlights, management discussion, corporate governance, and standalone and consolidated financial statements. It reports FY24 achievements including first full-year EBITDA profitability, first PAT-profitable quarter, revenue from services of ₹81,415 million, EBITDA of ₹1,266 million, and various operational KPIs (parcel volumes, PTL tonnage, fleet size, workforce, network footprint).

meta.title: Prospectus of Delhivery Limited (IPO Prospectus dated May 14, 2022)
meta.fiscal_year_convention: Indian fiscal year, April 1 to March 31; a "Fiscal" or "Financial Year" is labelled by the calendar year in which it ends (e.g., "Fiscal 2021" / "financial year ended March 31, 2021" = FY April 2020–March 2021). The prospectus also presents restated interim financials for nine-month periods ended December 31, 2021 and December 31, 2020, which are not full fiscal years. Industry projections extend to Fiscal 2026 using the same convention.
meta.data_vintage_notes: This is a statutory IPO Prospectus (under Section 32 of the Companies Act, 2013) dated May 14, 2022, filed ahead of listing on BSE/NSE. Financial figures are drawn from "Restated Financial Statements" covering fiscal years ended March 31, 2019, March 31, 2020, and March 31, 2021, plus unaudited/restated nine-month interim periods ended December 31, 2020 and December 31, 2021 (the most recent period presented). Industry figures (e.g., market size, projections to Fiscal 2026) are sourced from a "RedSeer Report" that was commissioned and paid for by Delhivery itself, so should be treated as company-commissioned market data rather than independent third-party research. Share/offer figures (e.g., number of Equity Shares offered) are explicitly marked "Subject to finalization of the Basis of Allotment" and thus provisional as of the prospectus date. Only first ~4 pages and the final (100th) page of a 100-page excerpt were reviewed.
meta.summary: This document is the final Prospectus (dated May 14, 2022) for the initial public offering of Delhivery Limited, an Indian integrated logistics company, comprising a fresh issue of equity shares and an offer for sale by existing investor and individual shareholders, to be listed on BSE and NSE. It includes company/offer details, risk factors, industry overview, restated financial statements (FY2019–FY2021 and nine-month periods ended Dec 2020/Dec 2021), management information, and other regulatory disclosures required for an Indian IPO under SEBI ICDR Regulations.

meta.title: Economic Survey 2024-25
meta.publisher: Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
meta.fiscal_year_convention: Indian fiscal year April-March; FY25 (or FY 2024-25) = 1 Apr 2024 - 31 Mar 2025; FY24 = 1 Apr 2023 - 31 Mar 2024; FY26 = 1 Apr 2025 - 31 Mar 2026 (forecast/outlook year)
meta.data_vintage_notes: Covers FY24 (actuals) and FY25 (largely estimated/provisional, including First Advance Estimates of national income for FY25 real GDP growth of 6.4%); many sector chapters use H1 FY25 (Apr-Sep 2024) data. Document is the pre-Budget Economic Survey, conventionally tabled in Parliament the day before the Union Budget (presented 1 Feb); FY26 figures referenced are forward-looking outlook, not actuals.
meta.summary: This is an excerpt (first pages, table of contents, and final page) of India's Economic Survey 2024-25, the annual flagship report prepared by the Department of Economic Affairs (Ministry of Finance) reviewing the state of the Indian economy across macroeconomic, financial, external, sectoral and social dimensions ahead of the Union Budget. It covers 13 chapters spanning the state of the economy, monetary/financial developments, external sector, inflation, medium-term outlook, infrastructure, industry, services, agriculture, climate, social sector, employment/skilling, and labour in the AI era.

meta.title: IMF Country Report No. 25/314 — India: 2025 Article IV Consultation—Press Release; Staff Report; Staff Statement; and Statement by the Executive Director for India
meta.fiscal_year_convention: Indian fiscal year, April-March. Document uses notation like FY2024/25 (=1 Apr 2024-31 Mar 2025) and FY2025/26 (=1 Apr 2025-31 Mar 2026); growth of 6.5 percent in FY2024/25 refers to the year ended March 2025, and projections of 6.6% (FY2025/26) and 6.2% (FY2026/27) refer to the subsequent two fiscal years.
meta.data_vintage_notes: Staff-level discussions for the 2025 Article IV consultation concluded September 18, 2025; the Staff Report was completed November 6, 2025 based on information available at that time; the IMF Executive Board considered/concluded the consultation on November 21, 2025; the Press Release is dated November 26, 2025 (PR 25/292). FY2024/25 growth of 6.5% and Q1 FY2025/26 growth of 7.8% are cited as actuals/outturns, while FY2025/26 (6.6%) and FY2026/27 (6.2%) GDP growth figures are staff projections made under a baseline assumption of prolonged 50% U.S. tariffs. The package bundles several distinct documents (Press Release, Staff Report, Informational Annex, Staff Statement, and Executive Director's Statement) of differing vintages within the same PDF; later pages (e.g. page 95) are a bibliography/references section for background chapters (e.g. on innovation/R&D and structural topics) citing sources up to 2025.
meta.summary: This is IMF Country Report No. 25/314, the published package for the IMF's 2025 Article IV Consultation with India, comprising the Executive Board press release, the staff report, an informational annex, a staff statement, and a statement by India's Executive Director. It assesses India's recent economic performance (FY2024/25 growth, inflation, fiscal and external positions), sets out near-term growth projections for FY2025/26 and FY2026/27 under a prolonged-U.S.-tariff baseline, and summarizes the Executive Board's policy assessment and recommendations on fiscal, monetary, financial-sector, and structural reform issues.

meta.title: Delhivery Limited Press Release - Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for Q4 and Full Year FY25 (Quarter and Year Ended March 31, 2025)
meta.fiscal_year_convention: Indian fiscal year, April–March. FY25 = 1 Apr 2024 – 31 Mar 2025 (year ended March 31, 2025). Q4 FY25 = Jan–Mar 2025 (the quarter ended March 31, 2025). FY24/Q4 FY24 are the corresponding prior-year comparatives (year/quarter ended March 31, 2024).
meta.data_vintage_notes: Figures are labelled "Audited" (Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results) for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2025. This is a stock-exchange disclosure (Regulation 30, SEBI Listing Regulations) filed with BSE and NSE on May 16, 2025, enclosing the company's press release. Document is only 3 pages (cover letter + 2-page press release); no separate "last page" content beyond page 3 was provided. Note a methodology change: depreciation and amortisation method changed to SLM effective April 1, 2024, which reduced D&A expense by Rs. 69 Cr in Q4 FY25 and Rs. 230 Cr in FY25 versus what it would have been under the prior method — relevant when comparing PAT/EBITDA figures across periods.
meta.summary: This is a press release (with SEBI Regulation 30 cover letter to BSE/NSE) issued by Delhivery Limited on May 16, 2025, announcing its audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4 FY25 (quarter ended March 31, 2025) and full year FY25 (year ended March 31, 2025). It reports revenue, EBITDA, and PAT growth (including Delhivery's first full year of PAT profitability) along with segment-level performance (Express Parcel, Part Truck Load, Supply Chain, Truckload, Cross Border) versus the corresponding FY24 prior-year periods.
